Markets.title: US stocks today: Nasdaq rebounds as chip stocks recover from steep losses, rate fears persist
Markets.summary: US stocks rebounded and the Nasdaq rose 1.73% as major chipmakers like Nvidia, AMD, Intel, and Micron recovered from a previous selloff. Meanwhile, stronger-than-October jobs data renewed concerns about a potential Federal Reserve interest rate hike in December.

Markets.title: Stock Market Highlights: US stocks rebound, but Nasdaq posts fourth straight weekly decline
Markets.summary: U.S. stocks rebounded overall, driven by gains in the broader market. However, the Nasdaq index still recorded its fourth consecutive weekly decline.

Markets.title: India's 10-year bond posts best week in 7 years, leads emerging Asia as oil slides
Markets.summary: Indian government bonds achieved their best week in seven years, outperforming other Asian markets as falling crude prices attracted foreign investors. This surge in bond purchases reduced pressure on the Reserve Bank of India to keep yields high.

Markets.title: British Airways parent profit drops on higher fuel costs
Markets.summary: British Airways parent company IAG reported a more than 12 percent drop in third-quarter net profit. The profit decline resulted from soaring fuel costs, aircraft engine issues, and flight cancellations caused by the Middle East conflict.

Markets.title: Trump Media's investors lost $2.2 billion while Trump holds $460 million stake
Markets.summary: Trump Media investors have suffered $2.2 billion in losses as the company's stock value has plummeted due to stagnant revenue. Meanwhile, Donald Trump still maintains a $460 million stake in the struggling social media platform.

Markets.title: Copper price falls for 4th day, heads for worst week since March on AI rout
Markets.summary: Copper prices fell for the fourth consecutive session on the London Metal Exchange, hitting their lowest level since late July. The decline was driven by a technology share slump and growing concerns regarding artificial intelligence investments, heading toward the worst weekly performance since March.

Geo-Political.title: AI stocks climb after trillions wiped from market values
Geo-Political.summary: Artificial intelligence stocks rebounded after investors previously wiped trillions of dollars from market values. The earlier sell-off occurred partly because investors feared a Democratic election victory would slow AI development.

Geo-Political.summary: Recent midterm elections provided early indicators for the 2028 presidential race. Analysts have identified four key takeaways from these election results that will shape future White House strategies.

Geo-Political.title: Two dead after bus crashes in France, officials say
Geo-Political.summary: A bus crash in France resulted in the deaths of one child and one young adult. Multiple other passengers sustained injuries in the accident, according to local authorities.

Geo-Political.title: New wave of bomb threats hit European airlines
Geo-Political.summary: A new wave of bomb threats has targeted European airlines. Investigators have found no connection between these airline threats and recent threats against media outlets.

Geo-Political.title: Kenyan doomsday cult leader given life sentence for murdering 191 people
Geo-Political.summary: Kenyan cult leader Paul Mackenzie was sentenced to life in prison for the starvation murders of 191 people. He had ordered his followers to starve their children to death in a forest so they could meet Jesus.

Geo-Political.title: Spain's rail authorities face European fraud probe after Urda rail disaster
Geo-Political.summary: European prosecutors are investigating Spanish rail authorities over EU funds intended to upgrade the railway line where a crash killed 69 people. The Urda rail disaster prompted this fraud probe into how the infrastructure money was managed.

Data & Insights.summary: Midterm election results suggest a slowdown in datacenter spending. This reduction in spending could help curb inflation, giving the Federal Reserve more room to raise interest rates.

Data & Insights.title: No fresh curbs on broken rice exports as India banks on steady paddy procurement
Data & Insights.summary: India will not impose new export restrictions on broken rice following stable paddy procurement. The world's largest rice exporter previously banned broken rice shipments in September 2022 before lifting the curbs in March 2025.

Data & Insights.title: Bond yield rise squeezes banks' Q2 treasury gains
Data & Insights.summary: Rising bond yields caused public and private banks to suffer treasury income losses in the second quarter. This elevated yield environment could continue to pressure bank earnings through the December quarter.

Data & Insights.title: Internship scheme's new pilot gets more takers post rejig
Data & Insights.summary: About 40,000 candidates have joined the third pilot round of the PM Internship Scheme, which is 2.5 times the turnout of the first two rounds. This positive response has encouraged the corporate affairs ministry to launch the full programme next year without additional pilots.

Data & Insights.title: India gets Strait of Hormuz passage reprieve from Iran. What does Tehran expect in return?
Data & Insights.summary: Iran is allowing Indian ships to pass through the Strait of Hormuz to secure vital medicines and energy supplies. In exchange, Tehran expects continued diplomatic support and strategic alignment from India.

Data & Insights.title: Food accounts for 53.5% of rural household spending as inflation rises: NABARD survey
Data & Insights.summary: A NABARD survey shows that food accounts for 53.5% of rural household spending amid rising inflation. This high cost of food is causing rural households to face financial strain by depleting their savings and increasing their borrowing.

India.title: Analysis: From Hospital Bed, Sharad Pawar Keeps Maharashtra Guessing Over NCP-NDA Move
India.summary: Sharad Pawar is a prominent political figure in Maharashtra known for his unpredictability over the last six decades. From his hospital bed, he has left people guessing about the Nationalist Congress Party's potential moves regarding the NDA.

India.title: 5 Killed, Several Injured In Road Accident In UP: Cops
India.summary: Five people died and several others were injured in a tractor-trolley accident in Uttar Pradesh's Sitapur district. A senior police official confirmed the fatal crash occurred on Saturday.

India.title: Delhi College Accountant Duped Of Rs 80 Lakh In 'Boss Fraud'
India.summary: An accountant at Delhi's Chanderprabhu Jain College of Higher Studies and School of Law was cheated out of Rs 80 lakh in a "boss fraud" scheme. The educational institution is located in Narela and operated by the Rishi Aurobindo Educational Society.

India.title: Man Confronts Tour Operators About Missing Parents. They Beat Him To Death
India.summary: Haider Ansari was beaten to death by tour operators after confronting them about his parents' delayed return from Umrah in Saudi Arabia. His parents had missed their scheduled October 24 return date.

India.title: Oil Companies Reject Karnataka Minister's '30% Ethanol' Charge Over E20 Petrol, Question Testing Method
India.summary: State-run oil companies have rejected a Karnataka minister's claim that E20 petrol contains 30 percent ethanol. The firms stated that these allegations are unsupported by testing conducted according to official statutory and technical procedures.

General.summary: The 82-year-old was arrested in Florida after the FBI searched two Los Angeles-area storage units he rented.

General.title: With Stephen Miller pick, Trump readies for a battle
General.summary: President Trump has chosen loyal partisan firebrand Stephen Miller to serve as his new chief of staff. This appointment is expected to trigger intense political clashes between the administration and Congress.

General.title: Brand's barrister refers himself to regulator after report he confronted journalist
General.summary: Barrister Ian Winter has referred himself to a regulator following allegations that he confronted a journalist outside a court. The reporter had previously investigated the comedian Russell Brand.

General.title: How 2000s lad culture helped Russell Brand to hide in plain sight
General.summary: Russell Brand achieved fame by capitalizing on the permissive 2000s UK lad culture. This same cultural backdrop subsequently helped him conceal his alleged sexual misconduct for years.

General.title: Harry and five others seek to challenge Mail publisher privacy ruling
General.summary: Prince Harry and five other public figures lost a High Court case against the publisher of the Daily Mail and Mail on Sunday. The group is now seeking to challenge that privacy ruling.
